entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to return something? I'm not really sure how it works. The website was a bit confusing.
I can definitely help you with that. Can I start with your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Sure, it's Sarah Miller. The email is s.miller.confused@email.com. I think. Let me check.
No problem, take your time. ... Okay, I see it. Sarah Miller. I see an order here from about three months ago for a VeloFit Performance Jersey. Is that the item?
Yes, that's the one. The jersey. I finally tried it on for a ride and it's just not right.
I understand. To make sure I get you to the right place, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's the wrong size. It said it was a medium but it's just way too tight. I was hoping to exchange it, but the return page had so many buttons... I just got overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely help you with this. Let me just confirm the purchase date... I see it was delivered 84 days ago. And for a standard item like a jersey, our policy allows for returns within 90 days. So you are well within the window.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was too late. I just want to get the right size.

Not a problem at all. We can definitely process this return and help you with the exchange for a larger size. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you now, and I'll email it directly to you. Once we receive the original jersey, we'll ship out the new one.
Wow, that's so much easier. Thank you so much, Charlie! You've been a great help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
Great. Have a wonderful day and a great next ride. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
